architecture_summary: Modular React app. Pages in src/pages/. Reusable UI components in src/components/. CSS modules for styling. React Router v6 for navigation. No state management lib (use React context for shared state).

tickets.title: Create Services Pricing page (src/pages/ServicesPricing.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert Stitch design to React. Static data for pricing tiers. Responsive layout. CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen
Pricing data from mock JSON file (src/data/pricing.json)

tickets.title: Build reusable UI components (src/components/)
tickets.description: Extract shared components from Stitch screens. Buttons, badges, inputs, table, toast, loader. CSS modules per component. Props for variants.
acceptance_criteria: Support all variants shown in showcase screens

tickets.title: Create 404 page (src/pages/NotFound.jsx)
tickets.description: Convert brutalist 404 design to React. Static page. CSS modules for styling.
acceptance_criteria: Exact visual match to Stitch screen

tickets.title: Implement Toast system (src/components/Toast.jsx + context)
tickets.description: Toast component + context provider. Auto-dismiss. Position fixed top-right. Support success/error/warning/info variants.
acceptance_criteria: Context API for global toast control

tickets.title: Add global loader (src/components/Loader.jsx + context)
tickets.description: Loader component + context provider. Full-page overlay. Spinner animation. Context for global control.
acceptance_criteria: Context API for global loader control

tickets.title: App shell, navigation bar, and router wiring (src/App.jsx)
tickets.description: Main App component. React Router setup. Navigation bar. Route definitions for all pages. Layout wrapper for consistent styling.
